subject: Quick review before sign-off
text:
I'd appreciate your quick review before tomorrow's sign-off. A supplier just moved their delivery, so the revised schedule may affect the opening display. Could you check pages four through six and tell me whether the timeline still looks credible?

I'm especially unsure about the handover step near the end. If it feels too tight, please mark it directly in the comments rather than rewriting it yourself. We have a short window to correct it.

Thanks for doing this on short notice. A simple yes, no, or caution note would help me decide whether to keep the original plan or ask for another delay. A Thursday staffing gap adds a small but real risk now.
